name: COVID-19 Vaccinations by ZIP Code - Historical
rowLabel: Day of COVID-19 Vaccination Metrics for a ZIP Code

columns.name: Zip Code
columns.description: Home ZIP Code of the person vaccinated.

columns.name: Date
columns.description: Date the vaccine dose was administered.

columns.name: Total Doses - Daily
columns.description: Number of doses administered on the date.

columns.name: Total Doses - Cumulative
columns.description: Total number of doses administered through the date.

columns.name: 1st Dose - Daily
columns.description: Number of people who received a first vaccine dose on the date.

columns.name: 1st Dose - Cumulative
columns.description: Total number of people with at least one vaccine dose through the date.

columns.name: 1st Dose - Percent Population
columns.description: The percentage of the population that has received at least one vaccine dose. This is calculated by dividing 1st Doses - Cumulative by Population. For ZIP Codes mostly outside Chicago, this column will be blank because reliable Chicago-only population counts are not available.

columns.name: Vaccine Series Completed - Daily
columns.description: Number of people who completed a vaccine series on the date.

columns.name: Vaccine Series Completed - Cumulative
columns.description: Total number of people who completed a vaccine series through the date.

columns.name: Vaccine Series Completed  - Percent Population
columns.description: The percentage of the population that has completed a vaccine series. This is calculated by dividing Vaccine Series Completed - Cumulative by Population.  For ZIP Codes mostly outside Chicago, this column will be blank because reliable Chicago-only population counts are not available.

columns.name: Bivalent - Daily
columns.description: Number of people who received a bivalent (updated) dose on the date.

columns.name: Bivalent - Cumulative
columns.description: Total number of people who who received a bivalent (updated) dose through the date.

columns.name: Bivalent - Percent Population
columns.description: The percentage of the population that has received a bivalent (updated) dose. This is calculated by dividing Bivalent - Cumulative by Population.  For ZIP Codes mostly outside Chicago, this column will be blank because reliable Chicago-only population counts are not available.

columns.name: Total Doses - Daily - Age 5+
columns.description: NOTE: This column is not populated after 3/15/2023.

columns.name: Total Doses - Daily - Age 12+
columns.description: NOTE: This column is not populated after 3/15/2023.

columns.name: 1st Dose - Daily - Age 5+
columns.description: NOTE: This column is not populated after 3/15/2023.

columns.name: 1st Dose - Daily - Age 12+
columns.description: NOTE: This column is not populated after 3/15/2023.

columns.name: Vaccine Series Completed - Daily - Age 5+
columns.description: NOTE: This column is not populated after 3/15/2023.

columns.name: Vaccine Series Completed - Daily - Age 12+
columns.description: NOTE: This column is not populated after 3/15/2023.

columns.name: Population
columns.description: Population of the ZIP Code.  For ZIP Codes mostly outside Chicago, this column will be blank because reliable Chicago-only population counts are not available.

columns.name: ZIP Code Location
columns.description: A point within the ZIP Code to allow for geographic analysis. The precise point shown has no other meaning.

columns.name: Row_ID
columns.description: A unique identifier for each record.

columns.name: Wards
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Wards' (43wa-7qmu) the point in column 'zip_code_location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

columns.name: Boundaries - ZIP Codes
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Boundaries - ZIP Codes' (rpca-8um6) the point in column 'zip_code_location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

columns.name: Community Areas
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Community Areas' (vrxf-vc4k) the point in column 'zip_code_location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

columns.name: Zip Codes
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Zip Codes' (6mkv-f3dw) the point in column 'zip_code_location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Census Tracts' (bdys-3d7i) the point in column 'zip_code_location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
